XHelpers Pro 1.0.23 (41)
- Screen Shelf: fixed a crash when opening the shelf for the first time after launch, which 1.0.22 caused once the shelf had been opened at its new, taller size. If opening the shelf ever stops the app again, the next launch resets the shelf's window size and position by itself and does not reopen it at launch; your images are never touched. - Reclaim Disk Space: every action that deletes something asks in the same way, with the count and the size it frees. In Guide Me, the button at the bottom always leads on (Continue, Next Undecided, Back to Groups), and a cleanup you set aside reads Later, one you keep reads Kept. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
